content: Avoidant or restrictive food intake disorder, also known as avoidant food intake disorder or restrictive food intake disorder, is a condition characterized by abnormal feeding habits. Individuals with this disorder may exhibit a persistent avoidance of certain foods or an overall restriction in food intake. This behavior can result in significant weight loss, severe nutritional deficiencies, and impaired psychosocial functioning. Importantly, the underlying causes of this disorder are not attributed to any identifiable physical condition.
